findings.detail: The new reason says the worker persists status before the parent returns. When workmux exceeds the timeout, await_launch returns 124 while the worker remains running; the status file is written only after workmux finishes. The existing timeout tests explicitly exercise this behavior.
findings.fix: Replace the reason with: '# error-output-allow: detached worker logs output and saves status on completion; timeout preserves the state directory'. Regenerate the mirror.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Function comments: The detached-launch reason incorrectly promises status before timeout returns.
